mapper.sql: from kb_document_chunk c join kb_document_version v on v.version_id = c.version_id and v.active = 1 and v.deleted_at is null join kb_document d on d.doc_id = c.doc_id and d.deleted_at is null

c.chunk_id as chunkId, c.library_id as libraryId, c.dept_id as deptId, c.version_id as versionId, c.chunk_index as chunkIndex, c.section_label as sectionLabel, c.content, d.title, v.version, v.filename

from kb_document_chunk c join kb_document_version v on v.version_id = c.version_id and v.active = 1 and v.deleted_at is null join kb_document d on d.doc_id = c.doc_id and d.deleted_at is null and d.graph_enabled = 1

select d.doc_id as docId, d.dept_id as deptId, d.library_id as libraryId, v.version_id as versionId, task.task_id as taskId from kb_document_version v join kb_document d on d.doc_id = v.doc_id left join kb_ingest_task task on task.version_id = v.version_id and task.stage = 'embed'
mapper.select: where v.active = 1 and v.deleted_at is null and d.deleted_at is null and (task.task_id is null or task.status = 'pending' or (task.status = 'failed' and task.finished_at < now() - interval 2 minute) or (task.status = 'running' and task.started_at < now() - interval 15 minute)) order by task.task_id is not null, v.version_id limit 1
where v.active = 0 and task.task_id is not null order by task.task_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into kb_ingest_task (version_id, stage, status, started_at) values (#{versionId}, 'embed', 'running', now())
mapper.update: update kb_ingest_task set status = 'running', started_at = now(), finished_at = null, error = null where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.delete: delete from kb_ingest_task where task_id = #{taskId} and stage = 'embed'
